checks.descriptionMarkdown: The disabled-behavior group without the `expressions` feature.
The same disabled-behavior group with the feature compiled in but expressions not enabled in `RuntimeOptions`.

Asserts PLT-1: the default normal+build dependency graph of `dxn_dtcg` has no QuickJS, oxc or `cc` package, and a default-feature wasm32 check succeeds while the wasm32 C compiler and archiver point at nonexistent programs (so any C compilation would fail).
argv:
set -euo pipefail
tree=$(cargo tree -p dxn_dtcg -e normal,build --prefix none --format '{p}')
if printf '%s\n' "$tree" | grep -E '^(quickjs-jit|quickjs-jit-sys|quickjs-jit-core|rquickjs|oxc[a-z_-]*|cc) v'; then echo 'default dependency graph contains engine crates'; exit 1; fi
CC_wasm32_unknown_unknown=/nonexistent/cc AR_wasm32_unknown_unknown=/nonexistent/ar cargo check -p dxn_dtcg --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
echo 'default graph ok'

checks.descriptionMarkdown: Runs the wasm32 test group under Node with `wasm-bindgen-test-runner`. Needs an LLVM clang with the WebAssembly target and `llvm-ar` (found through `LLVM_BIN`, Homebrew's `llvm`, or `/usr/lib/llvm-<n>/bin`), Node, and a `wasm-bindgen-test-runner` matching the locked `wasm-bindgen` on PATH. External toolchain, so never reused.

Asserts PLT-3 from `.github/workflows/ci.yml` as text: the existing `--all-features` clippy and test steps and the default-feature wasm32 check remain, and a separate Ubuntu job installs LLVM (clang and llvm-ar), installs `wasm-bindgen-cli` at the locked `wasm-bindgen` version, sets the `CC_`/`AR_wasm32_unknown_unknown` variables and runs both the feature wasm32 check and the `expressions_wasm` group.
argv:
import re
text = open('.github/workflows/ci.yml', encoding='utf-8').read()
for needle in ['cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings', 'cargo test --workspace --all-features', 'cargo check --workspace --target wasm32-unknown-unknown', 'cargo check -p dxn_dtcg --features expressions --target wasm32-unknown-unknown', '--test expressions_wasm', 'wasm-bindgen-cli', 'CC_wasm32_unknown_unknown', 'AR_wasm32_unknown_unknown', 'llvm']:
    assert needle in text, needle
jobs = re.findall(r'(?m)^  ([A-Za-z0-9_-]+):\s*$', text)
assert len(jobs) >= 2, jobs
print('ci workflow ok')

sprints.title: Feature, extension format and the evaluation core

tasks.title: The expressions feature, options, error surface and extension parsing
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Add the off-by-default feature `expressions` to `dxn_dtcg` with optional dependencies `rquickjs` (package `quickjs-jit`, `=0.14.1`, `default-features = false`, features `std` and `loader`) and `oxc = "=0.153.0"` (features for parser, semantic, transformer and codegen with source maps), declared once in `[workspace.dependencies]` (d-feature-options). Add the always-present surface: `EXPRESSION_EXTENSION`, `ResolvedToken::snapshot` (always `None` until t02), `DtcgError::Expression { resource, path, message }`, `DtcgDiagnosticCode::Expression`. Add the feature-gated `dxn_dtcg::expressions` module with `ExpressionOptions` (defaults and `with_*` setters for step budget, memory limit, stack limit and precision; module registries come later) and `RuntimeOptions::with_expressions`, keeping `RuntimeOptions` `Clone`/`Debug`/`Eq`. Parse and validate the token expression object per EXP-2 (only with expressions enabled), with an internal parsed form t02 consumes.

New groups: `tests/expressions_disabled.rs` (EXP-1; must compile and pass with and without the feature, so feature-dependent parts sit behind `#[cfg(feature = "expressions")]`) and `tests/expressions_format.rs` (EXP-2; `#![cfg(feature = "expressions")]`). PLT-1 is proven by `check-default-graph`.

tasks.title: Evaluate expressions inside token resolution
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Implement the QuickJS session (d-engine-sessions: lazy creation per resolving call, generated wrapper module per token, inputs through `JSON.parse`, value conversion with the integral rule, non-JSON rejection, depth bound and rounding) and wire it into `Resolver::token_cost` per d-dual-resolution: resolve `$value` as today, resolve inputs with `resolve_value` at `Position::Unchecked`, evaluate, convert, charge `max_value_nodes`, check depth, validate against the effective type, set `snapshot`, and record the token's cost from the result. Map caught exceptions to `DtcgError::Expression` (positions refined in t04). The sandbox hardening and limits are t03; keep a single place where the context is created so t03 extends it.

New group `tests/expressions_evaluation.rs` covering EVAL-1..3: snapshot and type rules, inputs through aliases, pointers and nested literals, hop/node/depth limits on inputs, missing targets, cycles through inputs, aliases to expression tokens, result conversions and rejections, rounding defaults and `None`, literal strings.

tasks.title: Sandbox, limits and determinism
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Harden the context per d-engine-sessions, adapting nsh's `sandbox.rs` (intrinsic subset, deleted `eval`, throwing function constructors, frozen prototypes with accessor members, frozen `globalThis`, throwing `Math.random`, frozen inputs, no dynamic `import()`), and enforce the step budget (interrupt ticks per evaluation, uncatchable), the memory limit and the stack limit, mapping them to `LimitExceeded { kind: "expression steps" | "expression memory" }` and `DtcgError::Expression`. Keep the runtime usable after every failure.

New group `tests/expressions_sandbox.rs` covering SBX-1..3, including repeated resolution equality, evaluation-order independence, no leakage between expressions or calls, and a document without expression tokens resolving under a memory limit too small to create an engine.

tasks.title: TypeScript expressions and authored error positions
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Strip `ts` expressions with oxc per d-typescript (follow nsh's `compile_native` without JSX), and map syntax and runtime error positions back to the authored expression text for `js` and `ts` (wrapper offsets; for `ts`, through the source map). Map `DtcgError::Expression` to `DtcgDiagnosticCode::Expression` in `DtcgDiagnostic::from_error`.

New group `tests/expressions_typescript.rs` covering EVAL-4: type annotations, `as`, `satisfies`, generics and interfaces erased; syntax and runtime errors with line and column in `js` and `ts`, including multi-line expressions; the diagnostic code.

tasks.title: Expressions across every resolving API and in affected resolution
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Make `project`, `preview_source`, `preview_occurrence` and `replace_json_and_resolve_affected` evaluate expressions like `resolve` (they share `resolve_sources`/`resolve_affected`; pass the expression options through), and extend the `DependencyCollector` with expression inputs per d-incremental. Confirm `to_document` round trips with expressions on and off.

New group `tests/expressions_apis.rs` covering EVAL-5: each API with an expression token, affected resolution after editing an input target, an expression object and an unrelated token (affected set and `apply_affected` equal to a full resolution), and the export round trip.

tasks.title: Expressions on wasm32-unknown-unknown
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Per d-wasm: define `__rquickjs_host_now_us` (returning 0) for `cfg(all(target_arch = "wasm32", target_os = "unknown"))` inside the crate, add `wasm-bindgen-test` as a wasm32-only dev-dependency (pin the version whose `wasm-bindgen` the CI runner will match; the local runner is 0.2.129), confirm the default stack limit works with the default wasm stack, and write `tests/expressions_wasm.rs` (wasm32-only, `wasm_bindgen_test_configure!` not needed for Node) covering PLT-2: an expression with inputs, a `ts` expression, the step budget and runaway recursion. Planning spike evidence: Apple's clang fails at link time; Homebrew LLVM (`/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin`) works.

tasks.title: CI job for the wasm32 expression build
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Extend `.github/workflows/ci.yml` per PLT-3 and d-wasm: keep the existing matrix steps (their `--all-features` steps now build QuickJS with GCC and MSVC); add an Ubuntu job with the pinned toolchain action and wasm32 target that installs LLVM (`clang`, `llvm-ar`), installs `wasm-bindgen-cli` at the `wasm-bindgen` version in `Cargo.lock`, sets `CC_wasm32_unknown_unknown`/`AR_wasm32_unknown_unknown` and `CARGO_TARGET_WASM32_UNKNOWN_UNKNOWN_RUNNER`, and runs the feature wasm32 check and the `expressions_wasm` group. The workflow run itself happens on GitHub after the push.

tasks.title: Imports and host-registered modules
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Per d-modules: `ExpressionModule::javascript`/`typescript` and `ExpressionOptions::with_module`; the in-memory module loader in the session (built-in names reserved, specifier precedence, relative specifiers inside modules), the `imports` declaration rendered into each token's wrapper module, static-only imports (oxc import scan), TypeScript modules stripped once, and module compilation once per session. Errors per MOD-3.

New group `tests/expressions_modules.rs` with fixtures under `tests/fixtures/expressions/` (a realistic single-file color-library-style ES module for MOD-4, plus small modules for named, namespace, re-export, live-binding and cycle cases) covering MOD-1, MOD-3 and MOD-4.

tasks.title: Document-declared modules through the request/provide protocol
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Per d-modules and EXP-3/MOD-2: catalog entries gain a kind; add `DocumentKind`, `DocumentRequest::kind`, `provide_module`, `provide_requested_module` and `replace_module` with atomic mutations; read and validate root `modules` declarations while folding sources (canonicalized against each source's resource id); walk each imported document module's static import graph and return `Resolution::Missing` module requests from `resolve`, the preview APIs and `validate_complete` (every context). Language from the extension.

New group `tests/expressions_document_modules.rs` covering EXP-3 and MOD-2, reusing the MOD-4 fixture through document declaration.

sprints.title: Rust functions: native modules, built-ins, color, macro and declarations

tasks.title: Host native modules and the JSON bridge
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Per d-native-modules: `NativeModule::new`, `.function`, `.constant`, typed-closure adaptation through serde, `ExpressionOptions::with_native_module`, identity-based `PartialEq`/`Debug`, the generated wrapper modules over a frozen hidden registry, error and panic mapping (`catch_unwind`), `TypeError` for argument conversion. The planning spike's JSON-text bridge avoids rquickjs's higher-ranked closure lifetimes.

New group `tests/expressions_native.rs` covering NAT-3 and MOD-5 (a module whose top level calls a counting native function, imported by several tokens, across two resolution calls).

tasks.title: Color conversions in Rust and the dxn.dtcg/color module
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Per d-color: the public API on `values::Color` (feature-independent) and the built-in module `dxn.dtcg/color` on DTCG color JSON. Use the CSS Color 4 sample-code matrices and published reference conversions for tests.

New groups `tests/color_conversion.rs` (Rust API, no feature) and `tests/expressions_color.rs` (the module) covering NAT-2: reference values within 1e-5, in-gamut round trips through every space within 1e-9, `none` handling, mixing defaults and hue interpolation, lighten/darken, alpha, hex both ways, WCAG contrast, gamut test and clamping, and DTCG validity of every result.

tasks.title: The dxn.dtcg built-in module
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Per d-native-modules and NAT-1: the helpers of `dxn.dtcg`, with `isValid` validating through the runtime's `ValueExtensions` and argument errors as `TypeError`s naming the function.

New group `tests/expressions_builtin.rs` covering NAT-1.

tasks.title: #[expression_module] attribute macro
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Per d-native-modules and NAT-4: the attribute in `dxn_dtcg_derive` (re-exported by `dxn_dtcg` under the feature), camelCase export names, `#[expression(name = …, ts = …)]`, doc comments as TSDoc, the syntactic Rust-to-TypeScript mapping, and compile errors for receivers, `async fn`, generics and unknown keys. Keep the derive crate's dev-dependency on `dxn_dtcg` path-only.

New group `tests/expressions_native_macro.rs` with trybuild compile-fail cases under `tests/expression_module_ui/` covering NAT-4.

tasks.title: TypeScript declarations for editors
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Per d-declarations and NAT-5: `ExpressionOptions::typescript_declarations()` from the registration data of the built-in modules, host native modules (including macro-generated metadata) and the DTCG value types.

New group `tests/expressions_declarations.rs` covering NAT-5: oxc parses the output without diagnostics, and the declared exports equal the run-time exports of every native module.
